title: Coordinated raid begins in Chittagong
detail: Revolutionaries led by Surya Sen attacked British armouries and sought to disrupt colonial communications.

title: Symbolic anti-colonial assertion
detail: The action demonstrated organized armed resistance and briefly challenged colonial confidence in district-level control.

title: Memory of sacrifice enters later political culture
detail: The uprising remained a durable reference point in Bengal's anti-colonial memory and youth-centered political narratives.
